:::{#exm-propensity-score}
#### Propensity scores in the severity example

In the population of @exm-exchangeability-strata,
the propensity score (@def-propensity-score) takes two values:
$e(0) = \Pf{A = 1 \mid L = 0} = 120/600 = 0.2$
and $e(1) = \Pf{A = 1 \mid L = 1} = 280/400 = 0.7$.
A severe patient is
$0.7 / 0.2 = 3.5$ times as likely to be treated
as a non-severe patient.

:::
